appearance_facts.fact: Five vertical bars left-to-right: Solar (yellow), Wind (light blue), Hydroelectric (medium blue), Biomass (green), Geothermal (brown). Wind bar is tallest, reaching near the 70 tick; Solar bar is second tallest near 40; Hydroelectric near 50; Biomass and Geothermal are shorter, near 20-35.

appearance_facts.location: above each bar, top of plot
appearance_facts.fact: Bold percentage labels sit directly above each bar: 41.2% above Solar, 29.8% above Wind, 18.5% above Hydroelectric, 7.2% above Biomass, 3.3% above Geothermal.
Y-axis runs 0 to 70 in steps of 5; x-axis lists the five source names aligned under each bar.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads 'Renewable Energy Production by Source'.
Categories in order: Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, Biomass, Geothermal.

public_definitions: User goal: 'Review the renewable generation mix dashboard, identify the largest renewable generation contribution source, then route that source record to escalated contribution review.'
Routing criterion (readonly): 'Largest renewable generation contribution source'
Option labels: 'Escalate Solar to contribution review', 'Escalate Wind to contribution review', 'Keep Hydroelectric in routine source monitoring'
uncertain: The bar heights and the printed percentage labels are visually inconsistent (e.g., the Wind bar is drawn tallest yet labeled 29.8%, while the Solar bar is shorter yet labeled 41.2%); the intended 'largest contribution source' is therefore ambiguous between reading the printed values (Solar, 41.2%) and reading the bar heights (Wind).
Whether the y-axis 'Reported production share (%)' values are meant to sum to 100% is not stated; the printed labels sum to 99.8%.
